timingRule: Timing decisions use the median of ALL comparable completed trials per workload/state/configuration, with raw values, min/median/max and actual external CPU/RAM/disk/power/network conditions retained. The initial plan schedules3 comparable trials, but no observed comparable completed trial is discarded. Failed/timeout trials remain failures. No pooling, retry-to-pass, unproven spike attribution or security/resource/rate/quality/rights/cleanup relaxation. Historical p95/per-sample-max forecast prose is not an adopted W3 timing gate.
rationale: The owner selects median timing for initial working software. Numeric unapproved forecast values are proposed starting targets with the explicit small-PC changes below; no historical tail/max statistic becomes a new timing gate. Resource safety, correctness, quality and original method deadlines remain separate hard constraints.
